supply.source: CHAIN conditional source study, 2026-11-12; tools/chain/supply-study.mjs; hashes in docs/chain/supply-study.json; not C2 telemetry

assumptions.catalog: Exactly3 permanent3-YARN ornaments; at most6 Epics consumed/player. No repeated sales, XP, stronger items or tradable output. Local implementation; not public deployment.
assumptions.demand: 50% independent persistent interest in each optional feature among chain adopters; no bot cosmetic utility. Independent style/forge interests are an assumption, not human telemetry.
assumptions.budgets: Universal20 grant, existing caps/fees, same shared balance. All seal preparation costs counted. Styles/forge ordering varied; no fiat inflow, growth or forced purchase.
assumptions.source: Conditional C2 drop-code study, not authoritative campaign receipts or empirical player supply.
assumptions.threshold: 52-week claims/burn<=2 and farmer/hour<=3x;5-year cumulative gate and final4-season activity/health reported separately. A quiet tail never passes health.
assumptions.interpretation: Fresh seeds measure model variation. A local receipt proves execution only. No result authorizes routine rewards.
